attempts.text:
**The window starts on a lone spine column.** Column 0, `yhaJ`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2% of calls, and the model names it in 99.8% with 0.08 bits. Column 1 is variable and the model names it in 18% of calls.

**A long spine follows, columns 2 to 22.** `yhaH` to `rlmG` through `exuR`, `exuT`, `uxaC` and `uxaA`, [[glucuronate catabolism]], carried by 95 to 97% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 19% of calls. The model names 80 to 99.8% there, fewest at `exuT`, 80%, and most hesitant there too, 0.63 bits. Then columns 23 to 24, `higB` and `higA`, [[type II toxin-antitoxin system]], variable, named in 92 to 93%.

**Columns 25 to 40 are spine again**, `fadH` to `rpsU` through `ebgC`, `ebgA` and `ebgR`, [[beta-galactosidase activity]], carried by 90 to 96% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 14% of calls. The model names 91 to 99%, fewest at `mug`, 91%, and hesitates most at `rpoD`, 0.38 bits.

**The last stretch, columns 41 to 79, is fork and variable columns**, in a region of plasticity in 11 to 49% of calls. The model names 77 to 96%, fewest and most hesitant at column 61, 77% and 0.85 bits. Branches carry their own families: a pilus branch of 5 families at columns 58 to 62, carried by 10 to 11%; `dsbI` to an aryl-sulfate sulfotransferase at columns 65 to 67, carried by 19 to 20%; `fitA` to `fitD`, [[iron chelate uptake]], at columns 76 to 79, carried by 16 to 22%. The window ends at column 79, `qseC`, in 42% of chromosomes.

label: yhaJ
facts:
WINDOW: the yhaJ window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yhaJ, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 595 to 674 from dnaA. Read in 534 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yhaJ once); 42,720 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.30 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,410 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; shell 7,843 calls, named 71%, 0.90 bits; cloud 467 calls, named 34%, 3.61 bits. Outside an RGP 37,713 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 5,007 calls, named 67%, 1.48 bits. Columns: 38 spine, 13 fork, 29 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.48 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (67% against 96%); 5,007 of the 42,720 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 61 ("FimD/PapC C-terminal domain-containing…") 0.85 bits, RGP 48%; column 59 (yqiI) 0.76 bits, RGP 46%; column 60 (yqiH) 0.75 bits, RGP 49%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 41-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 11-49%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0.2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: yhaJ "LysR family transcriptional regulat…". named 99.8%; 0.08 bits.
2. column 1 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 18%; 0.07 bits.
   1: yhaI S 80% "DUF805 domain-containing protein"
3. columns 2-22 (21 columns) spine: share 95-97%, all P, RGP 0.2-19%. Genes: yhaH "DUF805 domain-containing protein", yqjG "glutathionyl-hydroquinone reductase…", yqjF "DoxX family protein", yqjK "YqjK-like family protein", yqjE "phage holin family protein", yqjD "YqjD family protein", yqjC "DUF1090 family protein YqjC", mzrA, yqjA "DedA family general envelope mainte…", yqiM "protein YqiM", exuR, exuT "MFS transporter", uxaC "glucuronate isomerase", uxaA, ygjV "YgjV family protein", sstT, alx, ygjR "Gfo/Idh/MocA family protein", ygjQ "vancomycin high temperature exclusi…", ygjP "M48 family metallopeptidase", rlmG. named 80-99.8% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 13 (exuT), named 80%, 0.63 bits.
4. columns 23-24 (2 columns) variable: RGP 3%. named 92-93% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 23, named 92%, 0.37 bits.
   23: higB S 60% "type II toxin-antitoxin system toxi…"
   24: higA S 80%
5. columns 25-40 (16 columns) spine: share 90-96%, all P, RGP 3-14%. Genes: fadH, ygjK "MGH1-like glycoside hydrolase domai…", ygjJ "protein YgjJ", ygjI "amino acid permease", ebgC "beta-galactosidase subunit beta", ebgA, ebgR, ygjH "tRNA-binding protein", ygjG "aminotransferase class III-fold pyr…", aer, nfeR, nfeF, mug, rpoD, dnaG, rpsU. named 91-99% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 37 (mug), named 91%; most hesitant at column 38 (rpoD), 0.38 bits.
6. columns 41-79 (39 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 11-49%. named 77-96% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 61, named 77%, 0.85 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 58-62, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, all S; the branch's families: "pilus assembly protein", "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone", "fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher prot…", "fimbrial-like protein", "hypothetical protein"
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 65-67, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 19-20%, all S; the branch's families: dsbI, "DsbA family protein", "aryl-sulfate sulfotransferase"
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 76-79, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 16-22%, all S; the branch's families: fitA, fepC_2, fitC, fitD
   columns 41-51 variable, share 86-90%, all P: tsaD 90%, ttdT 87%, ttdB "L(+)-tartrate dehydratase subunit b…" 89%, ttdA 87%, ttdR 86%, plsY 88%, folB 88%, bacA 88%, cca 87%, ygiM "TIGR04211 family SH3 domain-contain…" 87%, ygiF "inorganic triphosphatase" 87%

   columns 53-57 variable, share 49-87%, 3 P, 2 S: hldE 87%, ibsE "type I toxin-antitoxin system Ibs f…" 49%, ibsE 75%, yqiK "flotillin family protein" 83%, yqiJ "OB-fold-containig protein" 84%
